request: a simple interactive ascii color mixing engine
thesis: Color mixing made tangible in a character grid: pigments go in, a blended color comes out, and density characters show how much ink is there.
job: open the page and see at once what it is (pots of color plus an ascii field)
pick pigments and add or remove drops
see the mixed color update live as hex/rgb and as ascii
switch the mixing model (paint vs light vs naive) and see the same drops give different colors
paint the mix onto the ascii grid with mouse, touch or keyboard
paint over existing color and watch the colors blend
save a mix as a chip and reuse it

principles: averaging in gamma-encoded sRGB gives muddy darks
tricks: weighted geometric mean approximates paint (yellow+blue = green, red+yellow = orange)
white lifts, black sinks, in paint mode both desaturate

principles: character density stands in for tone
steps: map ink 0..1 to a ramp index
tricks: colour the glyph, not the cell, so the dark shows through
tests: more ink gives a heavier glyph

principles: every control changes visible state immediately
tricks: readout beside the thing it describes

parts: pigment pots with minus/plus and drop count
expectations: mixing red and blue gives purple

kinds.name: pots and painting grid
kinds.what: drops of pigment make a mix, brush paints it on an ascii field

kinds.name: two-slider blender
kinds.what: color A, color B and a ratio, shown as an ascii gradient

kinds.name: diffusion field
kinds.what: colored seeds spread and mix on their own

descriptions: each pot is a button pair with a count
total drops capped around 12 so ratios stay readable
behaviors: plus adds a drop, mix recomputes

descriptions: each cell holds colour and ink; glyph from ink
painting over blends by ink weight
behaviors: drag paints a soft round brush

descriptions: UI chrome in muted grey, colour only where it means colour

anti_keywords.not: no layers, undo stacks, file export, curves or palette libraries (simple)
anti_keywords.instead: one screen: pots, model, canvas, chips

anti_keywords.not: naive RGB average as the only model
anti_keywords.instead: paint, light and naive models side by side
the ascii field is the hero

checks: red+yellow in paint mode is orange
yellow+blue in paint mode is green
plus button changes the drop count and the swatch
dragging on the canvas paints characters
painting a second colour over the first yields a blend
switching model changes the same drops' colour
works at phone width, no horizontal scroll
